title: Deadly Science
description: Some discoveries lie in wait for those brave enough to venture out; from hidden cities in the jungle to dinosaur fossils and seeds in far-flung locales, the prize goes to those willing to take the risk.

title: Pharaohs: Rise & Fall
description: Egypt is divided; local rulers called nomarchs vie for power, but only one will rise up to restore the kingdom and usher in a new era for the pharaohs; using literature, military might and conquest, the pharaoh and his forebears regain power.

title: I Died... And Came Back
description: A woman is hit by a truck while crossing the street, plunging her into an out-of-body experience that profoundly changes her life; a medical mishap causes a journey into a realm of light for a quadriplegic man.

title: Castle Secrets
description: A fairytale château provides an unlikely place of refuge; a grand fort in India.

title: My Misdiagnosis
description: Janice is injured in a car accident and starts having severe stomach issues that doctors diagnose as IBS; Holly is a young mother of two that is excited to be pregnant again until she starts heavily bleeding.

title: Into the Universe: Mysteries of the Cosmos
description: Billions of years ago, the first sign of life emerged on Earth; how exactly did this miraculous event unfold? As we probe the past, astronomers turn their telescopes to exoplanets to uncover vital clues about our own origins on planet Earth.

title: Nintendo 64 Quest
description: Jay finds a super rare game that he needs- but will he fork out the cash needed to get it?

title: Fishing for History
description: The boys head out to the UNESCO World Heritage Site of the Rideau Canal and explore the waters around one of the last hand-operated locks in North America.

title: Quest for the Lost Vikings
description: The expedition takes the Fara Heim team near Bloodvein, Manitoba where a large boulder may hold a great mystery of a lost Viking expedition. Meanwhile, Jo tries his hand at metal detecting near a historic fur trading fort.

title: Mapping Disaster
description: Some of the worst catastrophes in history, from the Liverpool Blitz of 1941 to the cataclysmic Banqiao Dam collapse and the devastating Haitian earthquake.

title: How I Got Here
description: Twins Ashley and Anthony grapple with the unresolved pain of their mother's decision to leave her homeland of Latvia.

description: As foreign invaders are driven out of Egypt, a warrior king takes his place on the throne; in the age of the New Kingdom, powerful royal women step into the spotlight and the empire expands beyond its borders.

title: Secrets of Ancient Structures
description: Angkor Wat is built as a stone replica of the universe, while the ancient Mayan pyramid El Castillo marks a sacred axis connecting earth and sky. In the hills of Ireland, the Newgrange harnesses the transformative power of the solstice sun.

title: Ghosts Off Grid
description: Less than 24 hours after investigating the Lizzie Borden House, Johnny and Jordyn arrive at the infamous Sallie House in Atchison, Kansas.

title: Into the Universe: Mysteries of the Cosmos
description: Tiny cosmic rays travel through the universe, constantly bombarding Earth with a stream of extreme radiation; scientists study these high-energy particles to understand their galactic origins.

title: Nazis: Threads of Evil
description: As the Third Reich collapses, the perpetrators scatter. A final look at the unraveling threads of the Reich's power asking how a regime of such horror could rise, and what lessons its end leaves behind.

title: Fishing for History
description: The banks of the Thames River in Ontario were the site of the battle won by Americans at Moraviantown during the War of 1812; after more than 11,000 years of human settlement, these banks may have more than just secrets.
